purpose: Shadow-only causal replay of fixed strategy-level correlation and open-risk admission caps on an already-produced ZackBot trade/event cohort. This is policy impact evidence, not strategy tuning or activation evidence.
hypothesis: Concentrated same-strategy same-direction entry clusters may increase drawdown and turnover without proportional net-R benefit. Fixed causal caps may reduce that concentration; all variants will be reported without selecting or tuning a winner.

causal_fold.source_order: Process the source's strictly increasing event_sequence. Timestamps are retained and may tie, but never decide a tie without the source sequence.
causal_fold.entry_decision: At each original accepted entry event, evaluate only positions and accepted initial-risk reservations still open immediately before that event.
causal_fold.exit_decision: Only an original terminal exit releases a position and its risk reservation. A causally recorded residual-risk update may lower the reservation; otherwise partial exits do not infer a release.
causal_fold.blocked_entry: Emit zero PnL, zero costs, zero funding and zero turnover. Continue to evaluate every later original entry in its original sequence; never substitute, rank, or look ahead to a later trade.
causal_fold.accepted_entry: Retain the original entry, all original partial/terminal exits, timestamps, quantities, initial risk, fees, slippage, funding and realized net result unchanged.
causal_fold.position_cap: Block when the number of currently accepted open positions with the same strategy_key and direction is already at the variant maximum.
causal_fold.risk_cap: Block when current accepted open initial/residual risk for the strategy_key plus the candidate's positive initial_risk_r would exceed 2R.

exit_or_cost_evidence: terminal flag or causally linked terminal event

fail_closed_if_missing: stable event ordering for timestamp ties
realized net R inclusive of preserved costs and funding
entry and exit notionals needed for turnover
source_sufficiency.trade_summary_rows_only: INSUFFICIENT when they do not prove the causal event ordering and exposure state above. No cap result may be presented as causal in that case. A clearly labelled descriptive overlap diagnostic may be emitted separately but cannot satisfy this study.
source_sufficiency.open_or_unreconciled_positions: INSUFFICIENT for performance comparison unless the exact window ends before their entry; they are not assigned zero or synthetic exits.

metrics.window: Minimum and maximum retained source event timestamps, reported in UTC and Africa/Cairo.
metrics.net_r: Sum of original realized_net_r for accepted terminally closed positions.
metrics.profit_factor: Sum positive accepted realized_net_r divided by absolute sum negative accepted realized_net_r; null with an explicit zero-loss reason when the denominator is zero.
metrics.max_drawdown_r: Maximum peak-to-trough drawdown of cumulative accepted realized_net_r in original terminal-exit event order, with the curve seeded at zero.
metrics.turnover: Sum of absolute original entry_notional and all absolute original exit_notional for accepted positions. Report source currency/unit; do not estimate missing notionals.
metrics.blocked_by_reason: Mutually exclusive primary counts using the frozen priority, plus a diagnostic count where both conditions were true.
metrics.concentration: Peak simultaneous positions by strategy_key+direction and peak open risk R by strategy_key.

reporting.multiple_comparisons: Three fixed cap variants are descriptive sensitivity cells. No scalar acceptance threshold, p-value claim, promotion, or best-cell selection is permitted from this study alone.
reporting.costs_and_funding: Use only the source-recorded amounts and source-recorded realized_net_r. Never recompute with a cheaper model.
limitations: policy counterfactual does not model market impact from removed orders
blocked positions cannot alter later price-only signals, but any strategy whose later signals depend on fills/account state makes the source insufficient unless replayed from raw causal inputs

roadmap_fit: Evidence-only risk-policy diagnostic for the active Binance/PAPER strategy cohort; no queue reorder or activation decision.
deferred: Runtime/PAPER enforcement, strategy changes, parameter selection, cohort promotion, and mainnet remain separate Codex decisions.
